title: Manuel Perez leading his band; Eddie Jackson on tuba
summary: Manuel Perez once led his band; pick-up bands had no fixed name; Eddie Jackson was a good tuba player.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did Manuel Perez ever play in his band? You played with Manuel several times, huh? Who Manuel? Manuel Perez.
Yeah, Manuel was leading my band once. I asked what the name of that band?
What was the name of that band when Manuel was the leader?
Was it the Onward? Was it the Onward?
Was it the Onward Brass Band or the Excelsior? Yeah.

Might have been the... Eureka? I don't know what, I don't believe his band had their name. He just made up bands, you know? Ask him if man was the one. When he get a job, he hired a man, you know? And after the job was over, everything was over. Ask him did he know Eddie Jackson, a two-book line. That's a good idea. You want to know if you know Eddie Jackson?
I asked him recently. He's a good place player. He could play. He could play, right? That's a good little tuba player. That's a good, good little tuba player. He was good.
